requirements.meaning: Additive migration preserves old reads and non-deleted data with correct final schema.
evidence: evidence/verification.json: interruption, old SELECT compatibility, recovery row/schema snapshots

requirements.meaning: At most two updated rows per batch; interruption is durable, resumable, repeat-safe and schema1 until complete.
evidence: evidence/verification.json: batch events, first interruption snapshot, abrupt exit23 and replay checks

requirements.meaning: Consistent v1 snapshot, isolated restoration and immutable source/backup with current deletions before publication.
evidence: evidence/verification.json: consistent backup, WAL snapshot, isolated recoveries, SHA256 and deletion checks

requirements.meaning: Actual interruption/restart, tenant/data/schema/deletion verification and local measured recovery.
evidence: evidence/verification.json: all checks and three raw recovery samples; README commands/limits

requirements.meaning: Proportionate 24-area coverage and explicit five-field decisions.

decisions.mechanism: Add nullable state column; preserve tenant/id/name and PK; set schema2 only after no NULL remains.
decisions.limit: Existing old SELECT contract; old concurrent writes/new state workflows not supported.
decisions.failure: Premature version or destructive rewrite loses compatibility/data.
decisions.verification: Real SQLite before/during/after snapshots and unchanged old projections.

decisions.mechanism: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, SELECT LIMIT 2, tenant/id conditional updates; afterBatch after COMMIT.
decisions.limit: Two updated rows per transaction; scan/lock walltime not bounded; busy timeout1000ms, no retries.
decisions.failure: Hook/process exits after commit leave partial backfill; rerun resumes using state NULL.
decisions.verification: Throw after first batch, actual process.exit23, schema1 and two pending rows then restart/replay.

decisions.mechanism: Read-only SQLite VACUUM INTO snapshot and fresh destination refusal.
decisions.limit: Pristine v1 source, filesystem storage/headroom and trusted single operator; full snapshot cost O(B).
decisions.failure: File copying a live WAL source omits committed data or overwrites original.
decisions.verification: Open WAL source committed-row snapshot check; source/backup SHA256 before/after restore.

decisions.mechanism: Private staging copy; tenant/id journal DELETE transaction, migrate, integrity/deletion check, close then rename and return.
decisions.limit: Authoritative journal supplied, at most10000 bounded keys; no adversarial paths/concurrent publishers; no traffic service.
decisions.failure: Stale/missing deletion input resurrects deleted data or target exposed too early.
decisions.verification: Required ledger validation, exact expected recovered rows, tenant collision, corrupt/overwrite negative checks.

decisions.mechanism: Three timed independent target restores through validation and hash verification.
decisions.limit: Four source rows, three surviving rows, local Windows runtime, uncontrolled cache; no RPO/RTO commitment.
decisions.failure: Misinterpreting local timings as production recovery SLA or claiming untested rollback.
decisions.verification: Raw recoverySamplesMs and median/min/max; actual files retained.

decisions.mechanism: Requirement/evidence mapping and all24 explicit task dispositions.
decisions.limit: Only supplied local SQLite path; no deployment/security certification or uninspected source claims.
decisions.failure: Unrelated technologies marked verified or missing relevant evidence hidden.
decisions.verification: Result structural audit and links to actual executed checks.

coverageDispositions.name: DNS, discovery, network paths and sockets
coverageDispositions.reason: Local file-backed SQLite uses no network or discovery.

coverageDispositions.name: TLS, certificates and transport identity
coverageDispositions.reason: No transport or TLS boundary exists in this local maintenance task.

coverageDispositions.name: Proxies, gateways, ingress, CDN and load balancing
coverageDispositions.reason: No ingress, gateway or deployed service.

coverageDispositions.name: Authentication, authorization and tenant identity
coverageDispositions.reason: Composite tenant/id preserved; deletion includes both keys. Application authentication is outside scope, not verified.

coverageDispositions.name: API styles, HTTP versions, RPC and streams
coverageDispositions.reason: Requested interfaces are local functions and CLI, with no HTTP/RPC/stream contract.

coverageDispositions.name: CRUD, upsert and bulk semantics
coverageDispositions.reason: Conditional backfill and tenant-scoped deletion; bulk updates limited to two rows per batch.

coverageDispositions.name: Validation, parsing, serialization and errors
coverageDispositions.reason: Deletion keys/count validation, missing journal and corrupt database rejection; errors propagate. Trusted CLI file size is not bounded.

coverageDispositions.name: Domain architecture and request lifecycle
coverageDispositions.reason: Explicit expansion/backfill/completion and staged restoration lifecycle; only ready target returned.

coverageDispositions.name: Runtime, memory, concurrency, OS and containers
coverageDispositions.reason: Native synchronous SQLite; connections close; abrupt process loss and restart exercised. General memory/OS pressure outside requested scope.

coverageDispositions.name: Database modeling and DDL
coverageDispositions.reason: Additive state column, preserved primary key and schema2 only after backfill.

coverageDispositions.name: DML/DQL, ORM, indexes and query plans
coverageDispositions.reason: Parameterized tenant/id mutation, old SELECT preserved. No query-speed optimization or universal plan claim.

coverageDispositions.name: Transactions, isolation, locks and consistency
coverageDispositions.reason: BEGIN IMMEDIATE expansion/batches/completion; committed hook interruption is resumable.
evidence: evidence/verification.json interruption and abrupt exit checks

coverageDispositions.name: Database privileges and operational administration
coverageDispositions.reason: Backup/restore source opened read-only, destinations must be new. OS authorization trusted; SQLite SQL GRANT/RLS unavailable.
evidence: evidence/verification.json overwrite refusal and source hashes

coverageDispositions.name: Storage, replication, partitioning, sharding and hashes
coverageDispositions.reason: Actual SQLite files, consistent snapshot includes WAL; SHA256 used only for integrity comparison. No replication/sharding.
evidence: evidence/verification.json engine snapshot includes committed WAL data

coverageDispositions.name: Cache, views and derived state
coverageDispositions.reason: No cache, derived view or external projection in the supplied fixture.

coverageDispositions.name: Messaging, event logs, CDC and async effects
coverageDispositions.reason: No messaging, CDC or remote effect. Deletion journal is an explicit local input.

coverageDispositions.name: Durable workers, schedules and workflows
coverageDispositions.reason: Migration is synchronous explicit operator invocation; no worker/lease/scheduler introduced.

coverageDispositions.name: Files, objects, search and specialized stores
coverageDispositions.reason: Separate snapshot, private staging and recovered SQLite files; target not published before reconciliation.

coverageDispositions.name: External APIs, webhooks, tools and MCP
coverageDispositions.reason: No external API, webhook or downloaded dependency.

coverageDispositions.name: Traffic, capacity, scaling and cost
coverageDispositions.reason: At most two rows per batch, ledger cap, three measured local restores; cost/scan limits documented without production capacity claims.

coverageDispositions.name: Reliability, backups and recovery
coverageDispositions.reason: Actual isolated v1 backup and v2 restoration; original/backup remain hash-identical; corruption refused.
evidence: evidence/verification.json isolated recovery 1/2/3; corrupt backup checks

coverageDispositions.name: Observability, objectives and audit
coverageDispositions.reason: Retained command stdout/stderr, row/schema snapshots, hashes and raw recovery timing; no deployed telemetry/SLO claim.

coverageDispositions.name: Infrastructure, build and deployment lifecycle
coverageDispositions.reason: Reproducible local setup/interruption/restart/backup/restore; compatible expansion and repeat execution verified. No live rollout.

coverageDispositions.name: Security, privacy, supply chain and lifecycle
coverageDispositions.reason: Post-backup deletion policy reconciled before returning target and tenant scope checked; trusted file/ledger authority explicit.

recovery.productionRpoRto: UNVERIFIED; local measurements are not a promise.

assumptionsAndLimits: Trusted local operator owns paths and supplies complete/current deletion ledger.
Only SQLite v1 fixture and requested old SELECT contract; no live deployment/traffic switch.
Synchronous maintenance, <=2 updates/batch, 1000ms busy timeout; large datasets/disk pressure/power loss/concurrent writers not tested.
Three four-row local recovery trials; uncontrolled disk/OS cache.
SHA256 proves observed source/backup file content unchanged, not backup authenticity.
No production rollback, encryption, user authentication, ASVS/ISO certification, vulnerability scan or remote RPO/RTO claim.
